column1: # Every THPS1 retail game function (0x80010000-0x800858ac; Psy-Q libraries follow).
# Boundaries from the static-recompiler's control-flow analysis (plus hand-found entry points reachable
# only via function pointers); names ported from the THPS2 demo
# symbols (FUN_ = no demo match). size = bytes to the next function (may include alignment padding).
# module: source file from the demo SYM; '~X' = inferred from the preceding named function.
